svg.aria-label: A decision flow with three questions down the left: can you list every acceptable answer up front, if not use a language model with structured outputs or function calling; does the answer need a written explanation, if yes use a language model judge or a language model plus Decision-1 for the score; is the input text only and up to 32K tokens per call, if not use GPT-6 Luna through the Decisions API or a multimodal model; otherwise Microsoft Decision-1 with a predicate, choice or score question, thresholds chosen on labelled examples and low confidence escalated to a person. A footnote says it must never be the sole basis for decisions about people
svg.title: Decision model or language model: a decision flow
svg.text: Can you list every acceptable answer up front?
Does the answer need a written explanation?
or an LLM for the text, Decision-1 for the score
Text only, up to 32K tokens per call?
GPT-6 Luna through the Decisions API
the same three question types, with images
Microsoft Decision-1: a predicate, choice or score question per concern, in one call
choose each threshold on labelled examples; send low confidence and refusals to a person
Not the sole basis for decisions about people: credit, employment, housing, insurance, education, healthcare, legal rights (model card).
Speed and accuracy figures are Microsoft's own as of 6 November 2026; test on your data before you rely on them.
